name: Conditions
content:
# Conditions

- **Blinded:** you can't see; attacks against you have advantage.
- **Frightened:** disadvantage while you can see the source of your fear.
- **Prone:** melee attacks against you have advantage; ranged ones disadvantage.
- **Stunned:** you can't move or act.

See also [[Resting]].

name: Resting
content:
# Resting

A **short rest** (1 hour) lets you spend hit dice: [[/r 1d8 + 1]] each.

A **long rest** (8 hours) restores all hit points.
